SessionStart.bash: printf '%s\n' '{"additionalContext":"[A Team] Read AGENTS.md and use /orchestrate init if .agent-sync/TEAM.md is missing. Run the project installer for project instructions and session metrics."}'
SessionStart.powershell: Write-Output '{"additionalContext":"[A Team] Read AGENTS.md and use /orchestrate init if .agent-sync/TEAM.md is missing. Run the project installer for project instructions and session metrics."}'

PreToolUse.bash: guard_root=${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}; if test -n "$guard_root" && test -f "$guard_root/scripts/pre_tool_use.py"; then python3 "$guard_root/scripts/pre_tool_use.py"; elif test -f scripts/pre_tool_use.py; then python3 scripts/pre_tool_use.py; else printf '%s\n' '[A Team] WARNING: project guard absent; run install.sh' >&2; fi
PreToolUse.powershell: $guardRoot = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT }; $guard = if ($guardRoot) { Join-Path $guardRoot 'scripts/pre_tool_use.py' } else { '' }; if ($guard -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $guard)) { python $guard; exit $LASTEXITCODE } elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'scripts/pre_tool_use.py') { python scripts/pre_tool_use.py; exit $LASTEXITCODE } else { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('[A Team] WARNING: project guard absent; run install.ps1') }

PostToolUse.bash: printf '%s\n' '{"additionalContext":"[A Team] Verify modified code and request a code review before committing."}'
PostToolUse.powershell: Write-Output '{"additionalContext":"[A Team] Verify modified code and request a code review before committing."}'

SessionEnd.bash: if test -f scripts/metrics.py; then python3 scripts/metrics.py session_end; fi
